item.title: Recommend a Sign Tested From a Distance
item.prompt_text: A sports hall sign lists the caretaker, the lost property desk and the first-aid point in lines of equal size. New visitors can see that there is a sign but cannot read the important line from the entrance. Recommend a layout, describe one trade-off, and propose a fair test from two locations. The sign must stay the same size.
item.audience: the coordinator of a sports hall
item.target_grammar: Comparison and modal recommendations; conditional test outcomes.
item.target_structure: Identify the priority reader and viewing distance, describe the layout, then specify how to test it.

checklist.point: Name the main problem from the entrance.
Recommend a layout within the existing size.
Explain a real drawback of the design.
Use both positions in the proposed test.
